records.name: San Salvador Council 283, Knights of Columbus
records.summary: A Knights of Columbus council at St. Paul Parish in South Philadelphia. Its members run food, coat and diaper drives, host a Red Cross blood drive, and take part in parish Masses and neighborhood events.
records.what_you_do: Help with the council's food, coat and clothing drives or its blood drive, and join the parish Masses and the Columbus Day parade it posts about.

schedule.text: No regular meeting time is published. Drives, a blood drive and parish events are posted as they are scheduled.

locations.label: St. Paul Parish, South Philadelphia (the address the council page lists)

cost.text: Dues and fees are not published on the pages checked.

first_step.how: Use the council's contact form to ask about joining or attending an event
first_step.basis: The site points people to a contact form for membership, gives no meeting times, and does not describe a first visit

records.notes: Two sources agree on the South Philadelphia parish link, and the council's own site is current. The parish phone number appears on the parish site under parish contacts, not as a council contact, so it is left out. The September 2026 Mass was read from the council home page listing and not opened directly. Membership rules are not stated, so no age or sex limit is recorded.

notes: Searches: all 8 used (budget spent, no more searches). Fetches: about 30. Only one record has current dated evidence on its own site: San Salvador Council 283 (a September 2026 Mass listed on its home page). Everything else is either an older dated item, a national directory listing only, or a lead. The Elks, Moose, VFW, American Legion and AMVETS finders are search forms, and I did not use them. Gaps: no current Philadelphia Elks or Moose unit was confirmed; the Grand Lodge lodge directory and the Knights of Columbus council locator were not reachable; Prince Hall and Order Sons of Italy lodges were found only as leads; no AMVETS post in Philadelphia was found. The Ancient Order of Hibernians Philadelphia divisions come from the national directory, and most have no working website, so their status is unknown and confidence is low. The national Hibernians membership page says membership is limited to men at least 16 who are practicing Catholics of Irish birth or descent and who are U.S. citizens or have declared intent to become one. That rule is recorded for each division. Suburban Ancient Order of Hibernians divisions in Delaware, Montgomery, Bucks and Chester counties were not checked, since they do not clearly serve city residents. Also seen but not checked: a Legion post at 9151 Old Newton Road that held a 2015 veterans town hall, and three ProPublica Knights entries (Phil Sheridan, Phil Kelley, 759 Council) whose locations were not shown. Regina Coeli Council 4921 is listed in an IRS database with its status automatically revoked for failure to file, which is not proof that it has closed, so it is not recorded. Only the San Salvador record has dated activity on its own site; the VFW and Legion records are low confidence and should be rechecked before publishing.
